name: The Site Book API
description:
Read-only REST API for The Site Book — projects, documents, workers, certifications and site attendance. Available on the Site Control plan. Authenticate with an account-scoped API key created in Settings → Integrations → API keys. Rate limit: 120 requests/minute per key.

Scopes:
- `read:projects` — List and read projects
- `read:documents` — List and read document metadata + download links
- `read:workers` — List and read workers
- `read:certifications` — List and read worker certifications
- `read:attendance` — List site attendance (check-ins/check-outs)
